title: Preserve source and output boundaries during snapshot publication
statement: The Views and traceability Module shall preserve source and output boundaries during snapshot publication within its accountable browser contribution to SR-087, retaining the stated limits of collaborating owners.

what.problem: A locally successful browser step can hide missing ownership or an invalid cross-boundary conclusion.
what.desired_outcome: Preserve source and output boundaries during snapshot publication.

why.rationale: MOD-004 owns the behavior necessary for the selected SR-087 criteria; the SR remains the system-wide obligation.

conditions: When generating, reading, recovering or qualifying the selected browser scope.

contexts: MOD-004 and its declared browser cooperation contracts.

how.approach: Apply the constrained Functions and preserve source, output, qualification and authority distinctions at the boundary.

how_much.scope: Contribution to SR-087 criteria 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6. Other Module contributions and final product qualification remain distinct.

acceptance_criteria: Reject an output selection overlapping authoritative input or requiring replacement of unrelated files before mutation; replacement is confined to explicitly selected generated output.

For invalid input, rendering failure or interrupted generation, preserve the prior complete readable snapshot or restore it through the declared recovery procedure before reporting successful replacement; an unresolved partial state is reported and never called complete.
Generation leaves canonical model bytes unchanged and includes only selected model content and necessary reading resources, excluding unrelated workspace content and private operational history.
Hostile text, links and paths cannot execute supplied script, escape the selected output boundary or cause undeclared resource acquisition.
Generation and reading do not publish or upload content. Publication requires a separate explicit action and applicable authority.
Equivalent declared inputs and tool versions produce equivalent declared snapshot content; actual provenance observations are identified separately from deterministic content.
constraints: Draft allocation; does not establish implemented browser support or requirement satisfaction.

sources.basis: System and Architecture Design from SR-084–088 and refined SR-060; proposed responsibility, contract and realization only. No implementation, platform qualification or product availability is established.
